versions.changelog:
power-electronics v1.3.0

- Added support for QR-Mode Flyback (flyback-qr) and Three-Phase NPC (three-phase-npc) topologies in calculation scripts.
- Simulink simulation guidance is now integrated, with links to ready-to-use templates and parameters.
- Expanded themed technical notes and script examples for new topologies.
- Improved output structure: clear step-by-step workflow and dedicated checklist for each case.
- Updated and extended the trigger keyword list for easier skill activation.
